integrity: The sharp upper bound and equality classification are proved analytically. The bundled numerical checker is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the Euclidean disk and quadrilaterals; larger even vertex counts and general centrally symmetric bodies are not settled. An obscure older result under different terminology remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Sharp minimal width of quadrilaterals inscribed in a disk
